draft.strengthQuote: Size and traits to play both tackle spots in even front.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 84th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 4th of 19 at DT. He lasted until pick 117, well after his grade rank (84th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tim Settle. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in sacks among the 19 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 66 career games and 35 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2024. Weak spots: pressures 1 (12th percentile), qb hits 1 (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 interior lineman who played: 1 pressures against a median of 6, below the norm.
